description: **First release: tree-sitter-go v0.25.0 in pure Go.** Translated from [tree-sitter-go v0.25.0](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-go/releases/tag/v0.25.0) (commit 1547678a9da59885853f5f5cc8a99cc203fa2e2c) with github.com/stricttools/wasm-to-go v0.5.0. Requires github.com/cgofree/tree-sitter v0.1.0. Parse trees and query captures are identical to a native C build of the same sources on 8139 inputs (go: 8139, 204 through the API).
